The surname '''Ayellin''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Corin Ayellin]] - a woman from [[Emond's Field]] and one of the best cooks in the village.
*[[Dav Ayellin]] - a young man in Emond's Field and friend of [[Mat Cauthon]].
*[[Jon Ayellin]] - a farmer in the [[Two Rivers]].
*[[Larine Ayellin]] - a pretty young woman and [[Novice]] in the [[White Tower]].
*[[Marisa Ayellin]] - a girl from the Two Rivers.
*[[Milli Ayellin]] - a girl from the Two Rivers.
*[[Neysa Ayellin]] - an older woman from Emond's Field and part of the [[Women's Circle]] there.
*[[Sari Ayellin]] - a young woman from Emond's Field.
